summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a 6-K notice determining the make-whole redemption price for its US$2.25bn 7.390% fixed/floating senior unsecured notes due 2028, of which US$1,276.632m remains outstanding. Redemption was elected in whole on 9 November 2026 (US equivalent: issuer call/redemption of debt), with the make-whole amount set at US$1,023.55 per US$1,000 principal plus accrued interest from 3 November 2026. No board recommendation or advisor. Surrender at HSBC Bank USA, New York. Watch liability-management optics and any further curve reduction via refinancing.
